name: BuildARing
author: Belgium Webnet Inc

sections.description:
In this plugin have only dummy data(diamond) for real data you need to purchase Pro version.

Demo | Pro Version

BuildARing is an application that allows users to integrate lab-grown and natural diamonds in real time through any marketplace or supplier. These diamonds can be combined with a variety of semi-mount settings that the app recommends based on the chosen diamond shape and different parameters like the carat weight and stone. Vice versa, you can also implement settings and get compatible recommendations for the shape of the diamond to offer a custom ring-building experience on the WordPress website.

Features

  • Real-time integration of natural, lab-grown, and colored diamonds from any marketplace or individual supplier.
  • Define markups for diamonds based on carat and price ranges, with different markups for varying suppliers and marketplaces, using tiered applications.
  • Engagement ring semi-settings can be manually added via the admin panel.
  • Bulk orders of engagement ring settings can be sourced from multiple suppliers.
  • Define markups for engagement rings based on price range, with different markups for various suppliers.
  • Import lab-grown and natural diamonds in bulk via the admin panel.
  • Real-time diamond integration via API, FTP, Google Sheets, or static Excel sheets.
  • Get suggestions for compatible settings when a diamond is selected based on the parameters range and stone shape, and vice versa.
  • Dynamic diamond search view with filters for shape, carat, color, clarity, and advanced filters.
  • Filter engagement ring settings by style, color, metal type, and shape.
  • User-friendly three-step process with two possible starting points (either select diamond first or ring setting first).
  • Review the ring before checking out.
  • Simple integration with your shopping cart for online sales.
  • Responsive to various screen sizes and devices.

Support

You can get timely and friendly support for the plugin and add-ons at our official website.
sections.installation:
1. Go to your WordPress dashboard → Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Upload the diamond-gallery.zip file
  3. Activate the plugin
  4. Add the shortcode [diamond_gallery] to any page
sections.faq:
How do I display in my page?

Use the shortcode [diamond_gallery] anywhere you want the builder to appear.

Can I customize the look of the desion?

Yes, you can customize the styles by editing the CSS file located in assets/css/.
